title: Better Terracotta CTM
description: 'Better Terracotta' is a texture pack that makes terracotta differences easier to see.
body:
'Better Terracotta' is a texture pack that makes terracotta differences easier to see.

*To use the CTM it will require optifine

**I highly recommend you to use this resource pack in Hypixel Pixel Party mode and games that have this same style.

**It supports:**
⤷ 1.12.x
⤷ 1.8.x
